title: Monday Night Open Mic @ Fast Breaks
event_description: A long-running Monday open mic for bands and soloists with a house backline and PA. Sign-up starts at 6:30 PM and slots can be reserved by phone.
backline: Guitar amp; bass amp; full drums; QSC PA system
event_venue_information:
Fast Breaks

Fast Breaks is a restaurant on Lisbon Street in Lewiston that has long served as a home for live music and its Monday night open mic.

Atmosphere and Setting

The open mic is described as drawing a consistently great group of talent performing for a discerning and appreciative crowd. Both bands and soloists are welcome which is unusual for a restaurant open mic.

Monday Night Open Mic

Every Monday at 7:00 PM with sign-up at 6:30 PM host Michael Krapovicky runs the open mic. Get there early for a premium slot or call (207) 782-3308 before 6:30 PM and ask for Mike to reserve one. The house provides a guitar amp and a bass amp and a full drum kit with a rotating weekly host along with a QSC PA system with video and multitrack recording capability.

Other Programming

Fast Breaks is a full restaurant so you can eat before or after your set.

Good to Know

Fast Breaks is located at 1465 Lisbon St Lewiston ME 04240. The open mic listing was last confirmed in August 2025 and the Monday night event appears on the September 2026 Maine open mic calendar. Call ahead to confirm.

title: Open Mic Night @ Gritty McDuff's Auburn Brew Pub
event_description: A Thursday night open mic at a riverside brew pub in downtown Auburn from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
event_venue_information:
Gritty McDuff's Auburn Brew Pub

Gritty McDuff's Auburn is a brew pub on the Androscoggin River with a deck and classic pub food. It anchors downtown Auburn and is part of the Maine brewery family that helped launch the state's craft beer scene.

Atmosphere and Setting

The riverside setting and deck make it a comfortable place to spend an evening. The pub schedules a different entertainment style on most nights of the week.

Thursday Open Mic Night

Every Thursday from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM the pub hosts an open mic night. Live bands play on select Fridays and Saturdays from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

Other Programming

Wednesday brings karaoke from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM and Friday nights include DJ sets from 8:00 PM to midnight.

Good to Know

Gritty McDuff's Auburn is located at 68 Main St Auburn ME 04210. Check the pub's events page for the current week's schedule.
